name: openpixo/isometric-pixel
title: Isometric pixel
description: Neat diamond-grid pixel props and scenes with a consistent elevated viewpoint.

description_i18n.en: Neat diamond-grid pixel props and scenes with a consistent elevated viewpoint.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 以统一的俯视角度与菱形网格，制作整洁的像素道具和场景。

examples.title: Village workshop
examples.prompt: Create an isometric village workshop using the isometric-pixel art style, with a mossy roof, a tiny forge and stacked timber. Keep every base aligned to one 2:1 diamond grid.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 isometric-pixel 美术风格制作一间等距村庄工坊：苔藓屋顶、小锻炉和成堆木材。让所有物体底座对齐同一个 2:1 菱形网格。

examples.title: Garden props
examples.prompt: Generate a matching isometric garden prop set using the isometric-pixel art style: planter, bench, water pump and short fence. Use the same elevated viewpoint and upper-left light for all four.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 isometric-pixel 美术风格生成配套的等距花园道具：花盆、长椅、水泵和矮栅栏。四件道具保持相同俯视角和左上方光照。

style.prompt: Isometric game pixel art on a consistent 2:1 diamond grid with parallel projection and no perspective vanishing point. Clean square-pixel clusters, crisp diagonals, compact stepped shading and a shared muted palette. Keep the top face lighter, the left face medium and the right face darkest under upper-left light. Align bases to the same ground plane and use nearest-neighbor scaling.
style.negativePrompt: perspective distortion, mismatched camera angles, curved horizon, anti-aliasing, blurry pixels, smooth 3D render, noisy surface texture, inconsistent ground planes, text, watermark

constraints.outline: One native-pixel contour; consistent 2:1 diagonal steps.
